dialogues.jp: 見上げた空は青い。
dialogues.en: I looked up at the blue sky.
dialogues.text: I looked up at the blue sky.

dialogues.jp: 俺の心もブルー。
dialogues.en: My feelings were blue as well.
dialogues.text: My feelings were blue as well.

dialogues.jp: 胸が痛む。
dialogues.en: My heart aches.
dialogues.text: My heart aches.

dialogues.jp: ジクジク、と雨にうずく古傷のような痛み。
dialogues.en:
It felt like an old wound which keeps hurting every time it
rains.
dialogues.text:
It felt like an old wound which keeps hurting every time it
rains.

dialogues.jp: 今までの激痛とは違う、静かな痛みだ。
dialogues.en:
It wasn't an acute pain like I'd so far, but more subtle
pain.
dialogues.text:
It wasn't an acute pain like I'd so far, but more subtle
pain.

dialogues.jp: 「かったる……」
dialogues.en: "What a pain......"
dialogues.text: "What a pain......"

dialogues.jp: のろのろ、と足を進めながら呟く。
dialogues.en: I mumbled while moving slowly.
dialogues.text: I mumbled while moving slowly.

dialogues.jp:
音夢には昼食を買ってくると誤魔化し、さくら
の家の戸をくぐった。
dialogues.en:
I told Nemu that I was going to get lunch, and went to
Sakura's house.
dialogues.text:
I told Nemu that I was going to get lunch, and went to
Sakura's house.

dialogues.jp: さくらひとりでは広すぎる部屋。
dialogues.en: The room seems to be too large for Sakura to be alone.
dialogues.text: The room seems to be too large for Sakura to be alone.

dialogues.jp:
返事がないので勝手にあがってみたが、部屋は
もぬけの空だった。
dialogues.en:
She didn't answer, but I decided to go into the house
anyway. I didn't find her in her room.
dialogues.text:
She didn't answer, but I decided to go into the house
anyway. I didn't find her in her room.

dialogues.jp:
「学園かな……いや、あいつは確か進学してな
　いはずだ」
dialogues.en: "Did she go to school? But she quit school already."
dialogues.text: "Did she go to school? But she quit school already."

dialogues.jp: どこか出かけたのだろうか。
dialogues.en: Maybe she went somewhere.
dialogues.text: Maybe she went somewhere.

dialogues.jp:
出直そうかとも思ったが、なんとなく待ってみ
ようと腰をおろした。
dialogues.en:
I thought about going home, but then I decided to wait for a
while.
dialogues.text:
I thought about going home, but then I decided to wait for a
while.

dialogues.jp: ――パチパチ
dialogues.en: Crackle.
dialogues.text: Crackle.

dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.jp: どこからか火の爆ぜる音がした。
dialogues.en: I heard the sound of fire bursting.
dialogues.text: I heard the sound of fire bursting.

dialogues.jp: そういえば、心なしか焦げ臭い。
dialogues.en: It does smell burned somewhat.
dialogues.text: It does smell burned somewhat.

dialogues.jp: 「火事？」
dialogues.en: "A fire?"
dialogues.text: "A fire?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あ、お兄ちゃんだ」
dialogues.en: "Hey, oniichan."
dialogues.text: "Hey, oniichan."

dialogues.jp: ひょっこり、と縁側からさくらが上がってくる。
dialogues.en: Sakura came in from the veranda.
dialogues.text: Sakura came in from the veranda.

dialogues.jp: 「よぉ、なんだこの匂い」
dialogues.en: "Hey, what's this smell?"
dialogues.text: "Hey, what's this smell?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「裏庭で落ち葉を焼いてるんだよ」
dialogues.en: "I'm burning the fallen leaves in the back yard."
dialogues.text: "I'm burning the fallen leaves in the back yard."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「焼きいもか？　それとも、とうもろこしでも、
　あぶってるのか？」
dialogues.en: "Are you baking sweet potato, or maybe corn?"
dialogues.text: "Are you baking sweet potato, or maybe corn?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「桜の花びらだよ」
dialogues.en: "It's the cherry blossom petals."
dialogues.text: "It's the cherry blossom petals."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あぁ、庭掃除でもしてたのか」
dialogues.en: "Oh, I see. You're cleaning the back yard?"
dialogues.text: "Oh, I see. You're cleaning the back yard?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「なぁ、音夢が帰ってきてたんだけど、あれは
　一体どうなってるんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Hey, Nemu came home, but what's going on?"
dialogues.text: "Hey, Nemu came home, but what's going on?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「見たままだと思うけど……なんか辻褄の合わ
　ないこととかあった？」
dialogues.en: "Everything's as you see it, but are there any problems?"
dialogues.text: "Everything's as you see it, but are there any problems?"

dialogues.jp:
ちょん、と座敷に足を伸ばしてさくらが肩を落
とす。
dialogues.en:
Sakura came into the room and sat down with her legs spread
out, and dropped her shoulders.
dialogues.text:
Sakura came into the room and sat down with her legs spread
out, and dropped her shoulders.

dialogues.jp:
「いや、別人になっちまったというかなんとい
　うか……洗脳でもしたのか？」
dialogues.en: "Well, I don't know...... Did you brainwash her?"
dialogues.text: "Well, I don't know...... Did you brainwash her?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにゃ〜」
dialogues.en: "Well..."
dialogues.text: "Well..."

dialogues.jp: 言いよどんで。
dialogues.en: She stopped.
dialogues.text: She stopped.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……音夢ちゃんの思い出を消した」
dialogues.en: "I erased her memories."
dialogues.text: "I erased her memories."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「お兄ちゃんへの恋心の発端となりそうな記憶
　を、全部音夢ちゃんから消したの」
dialogues.en:
"I erased all the memories which might lead to her loving
you."
dialogues.text:
"I erased all the memories which might lead to her loving
you."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「消した……」
dialogues.en: "Erased them?"
dialogues.text: "Erased them?"

dialogues.jp: ――パチパチと火の爆ぜる音がする。
dialogues.en: ---- I heard the sound of fire burning.
dialogues.text: ---- I heard the sound of fire burning.

dialogues.jp: 「おい、まさか庭で燃やしている桜って」
dialogues.en:
"Oh my god, don't tell me those petals you're burning
are..."
dialogues.text:
"Oh my god, don't tell me those petals you're burning
are..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「そうだよ。音夢ちゃんの中にあった、お兄ちゃ
　んとの思い出だよ」
dialogues.en: "Yes. They're memories of you which came out of her."
dialogues.text: "Yes. They're memories of you which came out of her."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「そりゃ……焼きいもなんて作ったら、さぞか
　し美味いだろうな」
dialogues.en:
"Well, you should be able to make one delicious baked sweet
potato with that......"
dialogues.text:
"Well, you should be able to make one delicious baked sweet
potato with that......"

dialogues.jp: 胸を押さえながら、唇をゆがめる。
dialogues.en: I pressed on my chest and twisted my lips.
dialogues.text: I pressed on my chest and twisted my lips.

dialogues.jp: そんな俺をちらり、と見てさくらが目を逸らす。
dialogues.en: Sakura looked at me for a second, and looked away.
dialogues.text: Sakura looked at me for a second, and looked away.

dialogues.jp: 「どこから覚えていないんだ？」
dialogues.en: "What won't she remember?"
dialogues.text: "What won't she remember?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「……細かくは分からない。首の鈴をもらった
　辺りとか、ボクがいなくなったころの家出と
　か」
dialogues.en:
"I'm not sure about the details, but the time she got the
bell on her neck, and when she ran away from home......"
dialogues.text:
"I'm not sure about the details, but the time she got the
bell on her neck, and when she ran away from home......"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「あくまで応急処置だから……上辺の想い出が
　薄まってるだけだと思うけど……」
dialogues.en:
"It was a temporary treatment, so whatever was on the
surface was diluted."
dialogues.text:
"It was a temporary treatment, so whatever was on the
surface was diluted."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「だから、兄さん、って言わなかったのか」
dialogues.en: "That's why she called me oniichan..."
dialogues.text: "That's why she called me oniichan..."

dialogues.jp: 想い出がない。
dialogues.en: She has no memories.
dialogues.text: She has no memories.

dialogues.jp:
それでは……音夢と俺の繋がりは絶たれたこと
になるのか。
dialogues.en: So does that mean we don't have a connection any more?
dialogues.text: So does that mean we don't have a connection any more?

dialogues.jp: 血も、心の繋がりもない。
dialogues.en: Not connected by blood or by our souls.
dialogues.text: Not connected by blood or by our souls.

dialogues.jp: 「……あ、痛たたたた」
dialogues.en: "Wow, ouch..."
dialogues.text: "Wow, ouch..."

dialogues.jp: 胸が痛む。
dialogues.en: My heart aches.
dialogues.text: My heart aches.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あ……うにゃ、大丈夫？」
dialogues.en: "Huh? Are you okay?"
dialogues.text: "Huh? Are you okay?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「なんかシクシクと痛むな……」
dialogues.en: "It aches......"
dialogues.text: "It aches......"

dialogues.jp: 胸をさすって眉をひそめる。
dialogues.en: I rubbed my chest and frowned.
dialogues.text: I rubbed my chest and frowned.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「とりあえず、このまま何もなければ、これ以
　上音夢ちゃんの症状が悪化することはないと
　思う」
dialogues.en: "So, if nothing happens, Nemu-chan should be okay."
dialogues.text: "So, if nothing happens, Nemu-chan should be okay."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "And then......"
dialogues.text: "And then......"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「このままずっと……関係をもたなければ」
dialogues.en: "You need to keep your distance from her forever."
dialogues.text: "You need to keep your distance from her forever."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp: 思わず笑みがこぼれた。
dialogues.en: I unexpectedly smile.
dialogues.text: I unexpectedly smile.

dialogues.jp: そんな。
dialogues.en: No way.
dialogues.text: No way.

dialogues.jp: 「はは……これっきり、なのか？」
dialogues.en: "So, this is it?"
dialogues.text: "So, this is it?"

dialogues.jp: 音夢の想いは全てなくなった。
dialogues.en: Nemu lost all of her memories.
dialogues.text: Nemu lost all of her memories.

dialogues.jp: 抱きしめることも。
dialogues.en: To be able to hold her in my arms.
dialogues.text: To be able to hold her in my arms.

dialogues.jp: キスすることも。
dialogues.en: To kiss her.
dialogues.text: To kiss her.

dialogues.jp: もう……何も出来ないと？
dialogues.en: And to pledge our love to each other.
dialogues.text: And to pledge our love to each other.

dialogues.jp:
今まで築き上げたものが、すべてが白紙に戻っ
たのか。
dialogues.en: I can't do that anymore?
dialogues.text: I can't do that anymore?

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「後は、お兄ちゃんが諦めれば終わり……」
dialogues.en:
"Now you have to give her up, and that will be the end of
it......"
dialogues.text:
"Now you have to give her up, and that will be the end of
it......"

dialogues.jp: さくらも辛そうに呟く。
dialogues.en: Sakura mumbled in pain.
dialogues.text: Sakura mumbled in pain.

dialogues.jp: 「終わり？」
dialogues.en: "The end of it?"
dialogues.text: "The end of it?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「音夢ちゃんのこと助けたかったら……そっと、
　しておくしかないよ……」
dialogues.en: "If you want to save her, you have to leave her alone."
dialogues.text: "If you want to save her, you have to leave her alone."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「今はまだ無理でも……そっとしておけば、少
　しずつは良くなる」
dialogues.en:
"It'll get better with time, even if it doesn't seem like it
now."
dialogues.text:
"It'll get better with time, even if it doesn't seem like it
now."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「ボクじゃなくてもいい……ううん。ボク以外
　の誰かを好きになって、新しくはじめて欲し
　いんだ」
dialogues.en:
"You don't have to like me. I'd rather you'd love someone
else, and start all over again."
dialogues.text:
"You don't have to like me. I'd rather you'd love someone
else, and start all over again."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……ごめん」
ぎゅっ、と拳を握り締めてさくらが頭を下げる。
dialogues.en: Sakura looked down, making a fist.
dialogues.text: Sakura looked down, making a fist.

dialogues.jp: 「いや、お前のせいじゃないだろう」
dialogues.en: "It's not your fault."
dialogues.text: "It's not your fault."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……ごめんなさい」
dialogues.en: "I'm sorry."
dialogues.text: "I'm sorry."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ボクは、お兄ちゃんを傷つけた……」
dialogues.en: "I hurt your feelings......"
dialogues.text: "I hurt your feelings......"

dialogues.jp: ぽたぽた、とさくらの頬を涙が伝う。
dialogues.en: Tears dropped down her cheeks.
dialogues.text: Tears dropped down her cheeks.

dialogues.jp:
声を殺して、肩の震えも抑えるように泣いてい
る。
dialogues.en:
She's crying, stifling her voice, and trying to stop her
shoulders shaking.
dialogues.text:
She's crying, stifling her voice, and trying to stop her
shoulders shaking.

dialogues.jp: 「……お前のせいじゃない」
dialogues.en: "It isn't your fault."
dialogues.text: "It isn't your fault."

dialogues.jp: さくらの泣き顔を胸にうずめる。
dialogues.en: I grabbed her and held her in my arms.
dialogues.text: I grabbed her and held her in my arms.

dialogues.jp: ぎゅっ、とさくらの指が強く腕をつかむ。
dialogues.en: Sakura grabbed my arm strongly with her fingers.
dialogues.text: Sakura grabbed my arm strongly with her fingers.

dialogues.jp: 胸に水の感触がする。
dialogues.en: I felt her tears on my chest.
dialogues.text: I felt her tears on my chest.

dialogues.jp: 本当に、うさぎみたいに身体も震えている。
dialogues.en: Her body's shivering like a rabbit.
dialogues.text: Her body's shivering like a rabbit.

dialogues.jp: それなのに。
さくらは声も上げずに泣きつづけた。
dialogues.en: Sakura continued to cry without making a sound.
dialogues.text: Sakura continued to cry without making a sound.

dialogues.jp: ◆焚き火をするさくら◆
dialogues.en: ◆Sakura's burning the cherry blossom petals◆
dialogues.text: ◆Sakura's burning the cherry blossom petals◆

dialogues.jp:
午後になって、音夢の状態をさくらに確認する
ことにした。
dialogues.en: I decided to check with Sakura about Nemu.
dialogues.text: I decided to check with Sakura about Nemu.

dialogues.jp:
やはり、さくらのしたことらしく、俺への想い
を断ち切るために、音夢の記憶を一部消したと
いうのだ。
dialogues.en:
Sakura said she erased part of Nemu's memory in order to
stop her loving me.
dialogues.text:
Sakura said she erased part of Nemu's memory in order to
stop her loving me.

dialogues.jp:
仕方なかったとは言え、ごめんなさい……そう
謝るさくらを、俺は無言で抱きしめることしか
出来なかった。
dialogues.en:
She had no choice, but I could only hold her without a word,
as she apologized.
dialogues.text:
She had no choice, but I could only hold her without a word,
as she apologized.
